_comment: Generated by tools/blackreach/blackreach_build.py from the plugins and Nate's Blackreach census (14 Oct). spots: every living actor of the Blackreach world (Nate's DragonBreak Online Edits placements, enabled or not, and the vanilla ones), spawned by wildlife.js as wild:<kind>:b<local id>-<plugin> zones; chests: Nate's ten, looted through blackreach.js; areas: spots and chests within 3500 units of each other. The Zcells stay dungeons.json's BlackreachLocation lease. Do not edit by hand; rerun the generator after a plugin changes.
